Theming targets
4 across 1 component
(key - component - props - states - className)

switch        Switch - size - checked, disabled - astryx-switch
switch-field  Switch - labelPosition, labelSpacing - astryx-switch-field
switch-label  Switch - astryx-switch-label
switch-thumb  Switch - size - checked - astryx-switch-thumb

Each key goes under `components` in defineTheme; it paints `.astryx-<key>`.
Props take a value (`variant:secondary`); states are written bare (`checked`).
One component in full: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <Name>
